headline: Iran claims missile strike on US radar facility in Bahrain
summary: Iran claimed it targeted a US radar installation in Bahrain, while Bahrain reported intercepting multiple incoming aerial attacks over its territory.
why: Bahrain hosts the US Navy's Fifth Fleet headquarters, making military tensions in the island nation vital to Persian Gulf oil transit security.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Military strikes targeting US assets in the Gulf escalate risk premiums across crude oil markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Direct military strikes against US security infrastructure in the Gulf raise geopolitical risk premiums on global crude.
